stones.title: Ebenezer stones
stones.intro: Write down what you've seen God do, so you can remember it when you doubt.

sos.line1: Get up, change rooms, and breathe deeply. This will pass, and you are not alone.
sos.prayer: Lord, I am weak and I need you now. You are stronger than what is calling me. Give me the way out you promised and remind me who I am in Christ. Amen.
sos.line2: When you can, reach out to someone you trust.
